title: Apply_Attributes plan revised as SendRRData explicit-message transport
purpose: Cover the documented unconnected explicit-message transport path with valid encapsulation and CPF structure while avoiding unsupported claims about undocumented Apply_Attributes service bytes.

messages.label: SendRRData with Null Address Item and Unconnected Data Item

expected_behavior: Peer parses a valid SendRRData frame, recognizes the documented CPF item pair, and hands the unconnected data item to the next-layer explicit-message parser.
constraints_preserved: Command-specific area includes 4-byte interface handle and 2-byte timeout
CPF item count is 2 in little-endian
First CPF item is Null Address Item with zero length
Second CPF item is Unconnected Data Item with length 4
issue_safety_notes: PK-only safe structural analogue. The unconnected data payload is intentionally minimal and not presented as a verified Apply_Attributes request.
